project.name: lorekeep
project.summary: A small set of written instructions that guide Claude through real engineering work in six steps: recall, understand, design or diagnose, build, verify and write down. It is mostly plain documents, plus a safety hook, a status bar and install scripts.

nodes.label: The playbook
nodes.summary: The top-level rules and readme that explain the workflow and are loaded into every session.

nodes.label: Core six steps
nodes.summary: The six steps of the workflow, each written as a short instruction sheet Claude follows.

nodes.label: Side skills
nodes.summary: Optional helpers usable at any point: research, cleanup, quizzes, secret rotation, diagrams.

nodes.label: Tickets and shipping
nodes.summary: Skills that connect the work to the ticket tracker and get finished work onto the remote.

nodes.label: Helper agents
nodes.summary: Two cheaper assistants: one waits out long test runs, the other reads the web and reports back.

nodes.label: Safety hook
nodes.summary: A short script that blocks a few catastrophic actions, like wiping the disk or writing secrets.

nodes.label: Status bar
nodes.summary: Shows the model, context use, usage limits and a live test timer along the bottom of the terminal.

nodes.label: Install scripts
nodes.summary: Link everything into the user's Claude setup, or remove it again.

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.summary: The tool that reads these files and runs the hook and status bar.

files.name: The rules
files.d: The main instructions: the six-step path, which model to use when, and the principles Claude follows.

files.name: Readme
files.d: Introduces the workflow and links to each step.

files.name: Web researcher
files.d: Reads the web for facts the project can't answer, checks them against official sources and reports back with a cited note.

files.name: Test runner
files.d: Runs long test suites or builds, waits them out and reports only the headline numbers and failures.

files.name: Safety check
files.d: Blocks a short list of disastrous actions, like wiping folders or saving secrets, before they run.
files.doc: lorekeep safety floor — the only hook.

files.name: Install
files.d: Links the skills, helpers, rules, safety check and status bar into the user's Claude setup.
files.doc: Install lorekeep for all personal projects.

files.name: Uninstall
files.d: Removes those links again.
files.doc: Uninstall lorekeep. Removes only the symlinks this repo created — never the repo itself, and never anything that isn't a symlink pointing back here.

files.name: Write it down
files.d: Records decisions and lessons worth keeping once work lands.

files.name: Simplifying designs
files.d: Guidance on hiding lots of behaviour behind small, simple interfaces.

files.name: Plan the build
files.d: Compares approaches, picks the simplest and names the files and tests.

files.name: Find the cause
files.d: Reproduces a bug and finds the real cause before anything is fixed.

files.name: Draw the map
files.d: Makes an interactive picture of how the project fits together.

files.name: File a ticket
files.d: Turns a plan that's already been thought through into a ticket in the tracker.

files.name: Build it
files.d: Builds the agreed plan test-first in small steps.

files.name: Quiz me
files.d: Tests the user on the subject area the work touched, so they learn it too.

files.name: Remember
files.d: Loads only the past knowledge the task needs.

files.name: Look it up
files.d: Finds facts from official sources instead of guessing numbers or rules.

files.name: Replace secrets
files.d: Checks that every password and key a project uses can be swapped without breaking it.

files.name: Ship the work
files.d: Commits, pushes and opens a pull request, then tidies up the branch once it's merged.

files.name: Start a ticket
files.d: Reads a ticket, creates a branch and hands the work to the six-step path.

files.name: Cleanup blind spots
files.d: Lists the things the cleanup scan can miss, so results aren't over-trusted.

files.name: Clean-up sweep
files.d: Scans for unused code, leftovers and an overgrown notes file, and ranks what to remove.

files.name: Understand the ask
files.d: Questions the user until the goal and success measures are clear.

files.name: Security checklist
files.d: Common security problems to look for when checking a change.

files.name: Check it works
files.d: Runs the change, compares it to the goals and hunts for breakage.

files.name: Code smells
files.d: Warning signs of messy code to watch for during review.

files.name: Status bar
files.d: Shows model, context use, usage limits and a live timer for running tests.
files.doc: Claude Code status line: model + token/context usage + Pro/Max rate-limit gauge + a live "⚒ pytest 7m35s" segment while a test suite is running.

labels: hands off slow or web work

steps.note: Claude loads the playbook and sorts the request into question, fix or feature.
Loads only the past knowledge the task needs.
Interviews the user until the goal is clear.
Picks the simplest approach and freezes the plan.
Builds it test-first in small slices.
Runs it and checks it against the goals.
Pushes and opens the pull request.
Links skills, agents, rules, hook and status bar into the user's Claude folder.
The safety hook is now checked before every tool call.
The status bar appears in the terminal.
